name: module lead
normative-structure: A module the architecture names gets delivered whole by a team that answers to one office, and that office answers for the module's high-level design being a thing a developer can build against without asking what was meant. It persists across incumbents because interfaces rot: the boundary between two modules is decided once, on paper, in a high-level design — or a thousand times, in code, by whoever reaches each collision first. This office runs the module's team the way the product development team leader runs the product's: 经理负责制 recurses, and so do its limits. It cannot alter the architecture that names its module — a conflict with the architecture goes to the system architect, and an interface change agreed privately with a neighboring module is two offices re-deciding the system's shape without the office that answers for it. It approves its developers' low-level designs for implementation, and it cannot certify its own module's delivery. The office practices guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness held in its left hand, standards conformance held in its right hand, and the space between is its realm — a record it produces is lawful as data and carried in a public standard format, never an ad hoc shape invented for the occasion.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: 概要设计 (high-level design) is module-level work owned by the module's lead, opened against an architecture already decided and closed by a technical review the lead does not run — the design chain 架构 → 概要设计 → 详细设计 assigns each document to the office that answers for its altitude

huidu-guanli/ipd: 经理负责制 — the module lead answers for the module the way the product development team leader answers for the charter, running the team and answering for delivery while the powers above it (architecture, certification, funding) stay above it

ieee-1016: a software design description is organized as design views governed by declared design viewpoints, each with its design language stated — the interface view is the part a neighboring module builds against, which is why the interface is module property and not unit property

guanli kexin development: mathematical lawfulness in the left hand — records as facts a machine can check, EAVT datoms and lawful events; standards conformance in the right hand — public formats such as ActivityPub, CloudEvents, and the ISO/IEC/IEEE information items, never ad hoc shapes; the space between the hands is the office's realm — per huidu-guanli/kexin, trustworthiness is built in at design and ranks above feature and schedule
unrealized: no architecture has decomposed anything, so this office presides over a design chain with no module to lead — the seat is real and its subject matter is not yet

one office presently stands for every module lead; when the architecture names more than one module, this record must either become a form that seats per-module or be re-derived, and that decision is not yet taken
no high-level design exists, so the approval power over low-level designs has never had a design to approve against
